findings.title: Plugin request logs no longer include traceID
findings.body: The previous logRequest appended `traceID` from `tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false)` to the `Plugin Request Completed` log params. This change removes that field entirely, and the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware only adds endpoint, pluginId, dsName/dsUID, and uname. As a result these plugin request logs lose trace correlation, which is a regression for debugging and tracing. Add `traceID` to `logParams` (or to `instrumentContext`) before logging.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh logger, hiding logs made via FromContext
findings.body: LoggerMiddleware now logs through `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`. A TestLogger passed to NewLoggerMiddleware will have `FromContext` return a brand-new TestLogger, so the original TestLogger's `InfoLogs` (and other log fields) will not be incremented. Any existing or future logger middleware test using this fake cannot observe the log call. Return `f` (or otherwise share the log fields) so FromContext preserves observability.

findings.title: Logger name still says 'plugin.instrumentation'
findings.body: After renaming InstrumentationMiddleware to MetricsMiddleware and adding ContextualLoggerMiddleware, the logger for LoggerMiddleware is still constructed with `log.New("plugin.instrumentation")`. Log messages emitted by the request logger will continue to appear under the old instrumentation name, which is misleading and inconsistent with the PR's naming goal. Rename it to reflect the actual logger purpose (for example `plugin.requests` or `plugin.logger`).
